title: Colby approves Pentagon policy for ‘cyber operations-peculiar’ monetary awards
summary: The COPA initiative allows for the issuance of cash bonuses up to $2,500 to eligible troops to “recognize exceptional contributions rooted in novel actions, inventions, or technical achievements that significantly enhance DoW cyberspace operations capabilities.” The post Colby approves Pentagon policy for ‘cyber operations-peculiar’ monetary awards appeared first on DefenseScoop .
